items.text: Oh, hi! 🫣
So last time I was talking to y’all here in December, I said that our Post-Release Patch 6 would be our last patch for Possessor(s) and uh, I LIED, I am SORRY.
With the launch of Possessor(s) on the Nintendo Switch 2 (!!!), we revisited a few little things that were bothering us, with some additional bug fixes! Complete patch notes below.
As part of the launch of the game on Nintendo Switch 2, a new permanent lower price for the game is live on all platforms the Possessor(s) was released on; it is now $9.99USD!
Alright, Myriame out (for real, this time). ✌🏻 🖤 xo
Gameplay

In our last patch, we pushed the little Map Progress Tracking functionality (a little tracking for items that players can pick up in the world), and it shipped a little broken for some regions; it is now fixed!
Fixed broken POIs (markers on the map not showing for Quests)
Fixed the marker for the final objective of the “Floral Findings” not showing on the map
Fixed the marker for the final objective of “The Last Season” not showing on the map
Fixed "Bad Neighbours" objective markers not showing on the map
Fixed the issue where 'Collect X Microfilms' objectives would never complete
Fixed the vault sequence so \ flies in, as intended, instead of just popping into existence (lmao)
UI
Fixed the issue where hovering a Quest Marker would often not open the Quest Details panel
Fixed the issue where the Region label would not update when changing selection in the Quest List
Fixed the issue where the checkbox in the Quest Details panel would be weirdly aligned for any 'collect x' objective
Fixed the issue where the flashback dots effect could get stuck on the screen after any flashback
Localization
Fixed some typos in various languages
Oke byyyeeeeee xo
Hey everyone!
As mentioned last week, in our Post-Release Patch 5 notes, this is our last patch for Possessor(s).

I want to take a moment to thanks the incredible people we had the immense chance to work with at Devolver. I have to do a special shout-out to Adoné, who was my producer-in-crime throughout the whole project, and championed both the team and POSSESSOR(S) on multiple occasions. 🖤

I also want to thanks the folks at Lionbridge Games, who were all absolutely incredible with supporting us with QA. We have shipped a very stable game, and kept improving with every post-release patches and it wouldn’t have been done without them. Shoutout to whoever ended up assigned with my multiple “so uh, i was maybe? doing this action in this very specific corner of X region and SOMEHOW BROKE EVERYTHING and i don’t know how or why i can’t reproduce pls help i don’t know what’s going on”. 🥺
Also a special shout out to White Paper Games, who jumped in in the late stage of production to support us with performance, lighting, and \, and were SO FAST and SO GOOD at everything.
… I am almost done, please indulge me this is my last big task on this project and I am EMOTIONAL OKE 😭

To the Possessor(s) Team: thank you, love you, miss you. I hope everyone can lend on their feet, and that we get to collaborate more on other projects in the future. You all have been so resilient, collaborated beautifully, and made an incredibly special game. You should all be proud of yourself, because I am profoundly proud of you.

And to our beautiful Heart Machine community on Discord, and all of the people who tried our game, gave us feedback, supported and and gave us grace while we were figuring stuff out post-release after having to go through exeptional hard times: thank you. 🦞
Alright, Myriame out. ✌🏻 🖤
Gameplay
WE HEARD YOU! Things are HARD TO FIND SOMETIMES, so we pushed a little Map Progress Tracking functionality~
Note that this does not include every items in the game but every “items in the world that player picks up”, should help with the backtracking :3
This is shown while hovering a region on the map, with an icon below the region’s name!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051013/0ca4a0dfe8e6c2da0901af5cc6590b080295819f.png"]
Hovering over a Locked Door icon on the map now displays which key is required to open it
Added an Auto-Skip functionality for dialogue moments
There is a color change to the advance icon based on whether dialogue skipping is enabled (turns green when enabled)
Adjusted an Aquarium shortcut to prevent players from bypassing it
Damage window adjustments for the Cellphone
Moved a checkpoint in the Sunken City to prevent player to go out of bound if they would dash through a door at the exact same time the game was saving from passing the checkpoint
Allow dialogue choice HUBs with a Leave option to be backed out of via back button (FINALLY we so wanted this for SO LONG internally lmaoo)
Fixed bosses infinite poise break exploit
Fixed a misplaced pickup in Park
Fixed some collision issues around the world (specifically one waterfall and one car in Streets!)
Fixed the Running Man (yes, it is its name aha) grapple bug where it would LAUNCH LUCA REAL DAMN FAR
Audio

Fixed a bug were the “Form” (as called in the OST) tracks in all regions would not trigger appropriately, resulting in either moments of complete silence in the ambiance music or only having the “Essence” tracks play
Narrative

We have made a huge push and changes to some of our narrative flags, to help prevent any other problem related to save/quit/load right as a quest was completed, and ended up not being flagged as completed on game reload. Any broken quests or side quests that would never be marked completed (or Professor Foss just deciding to DISSAPEAR?!??! after his main quest, making his side quest impossible to trigger) should all triggered as complete on starting the game. 🙏🏻
Heya! Myriame here, producer on POSSESSOR(S), the one who has been writing those little patch notes these past few weeks. ☺️
First off, from the whole team, thank you for playing our game, collaborating on lobster locations, helping others within the Steam forum or our official Discord, and giving us feedback since launch!

For those unaware, we have lost most of our team before launch to layoffs, and all of the post-launch support has been made by a small skeleton crew. This was not easy, but I am personally very proud of the work we have achieved with the limited resources we had. The remaining crew went above and beyond to fix bugs and respond to feedback (and tolerating my annoying multiple times a day poke on Slack, going: IS THIS FIX YET??!?!??!!). But despite it all we have, I believe, addressed most of the reports we have received within the past few weeks.

I wanted to let you know that this patch is the second-to-last one we will be able to have out. We still have QoL things we want to get in, and a few more bug fixes planned for next week, but afterward, no more patches will be coming out for POSSESSOR(S). The remaining skeleton crew is either also being let go or moving to another project.

Again, thank you so much for your support, whether you were following along during production or joined in after we launched! We all wish to have launched this game under better circumstances, but it doesn’t negate the fact that we are very proud of it, and we hope you’ve enjoyed and continue to enjoy playing POSSESSOR(S). 🖤

notes.title: ALRIGHT ENOUGH RAMBLING MYRIAME, here’s the patch notes

items.text: Gameplay

WE HAVE DONE IT. 🎉 Added a “Mini-Cheekers” (it is not really a mini version of Cheekers, but this is how we called it internally) close to the beginning of the Park. Mini-Cheekers will be selling a small number of health upgrades for the early game, as we have received a lot of feedback about folks missing Beverly/that she was coming too late for the amount of upgrades people were collecting before hitting the Mall.
Fixed for Nightmare in Campus dropping two Super Gems instead of one (for those who enjoyed this exploit, very sorry)
Fixed a duplicate item in Campus
Fixed a few collision/geo issues, odd portal collision between regions, and walls without collisions across the world
Added a shortcut in the Labs — this is a little fix for those who reported having to traverse the whole level to go back out was a very long trek!
Around the middle of the map, a one-way portal can be triggered to fast travel to the beginning of the Labs
It is blocked by a one-way gate, so once it is open, you can re-enter that room at any time
The shortcut is after a few encounters, but right before the most difficult chunk of the level
We have fixed-ish Baby Squid and Squid getting out of the water
They are behaving better, but it is not a guaranteed fix. Turns out, Squids have a mind of their own; they can not be tamed
Fixed Tygo becoming invisible sometimes on death/reload, as well as Tygo getting stuck when phase change is triggered mid-Gale attack
Fixed a duplicate email found twice around the world
Fixed a particular room in the Mall where enemies would stack in front of a door and make it difficult to get past them
Fixed the Interact prompt that randomly does not show up on some locked doors
Visual
Fixed the Whip point reappearing after dying & reloading into the game to Whip Walls that don’t exist anymore and just… floating.. being obnoxious
Fixed \ splash SFX when entering the sequence at the Vault
Audio
Fixed the Chroma Bank infinite audio loop if pausing the game as banking is happening
Controller
Fixed the controller infinitely vibrating if the whip was being triggered/active at the exact moment Luca enters a Subway station (this is so specific, QA is amazing finding those things, truly 🙏🏻)
Small patch this week as it is a holiday in the US and the studio was closed (we still worked, because we love giving y’all COOL PATCHES)
Gameplay
Update on our investigation about if Cheekers could pick up some of Beverly’s work and provide health/flasks upgrade for the early game 👀
Seems possible! 🎉 Would most likely be coming to next week’s patch after some additional testing!!
Fixed Luca getting stuck after performing Dive Breaker on certain ground assets in the Park and Dockyard
We’ve added additional Potency items to vendors to circumvent the “missing” items, preventing players from achieving the Maximum Dosage+Painkiller achievements.
Additional Potency items can be found in the Plaza and Streets vendors.
Fixed a bug where Luca gets locked into idle after very specifically jumping from a ladder and throwing the whip at the exact same time
Highly specific but uh, yeah it’s fixed now aha
Fixed (again!) Luca getting her head stuck under a slide gap in the Streets (stop!! doing this!!)
Fixed an invisible ladder in the Streets
Fixed the affix Regenerative Blood being found in two different places in the world
Gameplay
Potential fix for the issue where players could get stuck on the loading screen when starting a new game
This one was very hard to reproduce and verify. If you are still experiencing this issue, please report it to our Discord bug submission channel. Any assistance is appreciated!
Fixed a few out-of-bounds issues in the Streets
Fixed triggering the Benchwarmer boss fight by using Wall Run from the room below it
Fixed a few lingering Interact prompts that would bring Luca out of bounds
Fixed a lingering Interact prompt in the Salvager boss fight arena
Fixed an inaccessible room in Sunken City
A ladder was supposed to be flagged as always activated, but it was not. We did enjoy seeing all your very creative ways to access it, though!! Good jorbs.
Added a checkpoint before the Nightmare boss fight in the Campus
Fixed a little freebie item from a Vendor
Fixed a dupe exploit for a Super Gem
Economy: bumped up enemy Chroma drops, dropped costs of some items in Vendor shops
Investigating if Cheekers could pick up some of Beverly’s work and provide health/flasks upgrade for the early game (no promises on this one! It is a hard one to pull off!)
Visual
Removed the decorative lobsters in the Aquarium as they were confusing (oops)
Combat
Many fixes went in for the Benchwarmer fight
Can no longer whip Cone Hulk when it's hidden (spoilers!!)
Fixed an exploit for the final boss fight
Fixed the infinite parry exploit with Coach Fredrick
This was a very fun one, though, so we kept some part of it in aha
UI
We are investigating adding which Key is required while hovering on a Locked Door icon on the map
Gameplay
Fixed a few Campus bookshelves that were refusing to either be pulled or pushed, as well as verifying every single one of them. Those pesky bookshelves.
Fixed a save issue where, if forcefully closing the game during the cutscene or conversation before the General’s fight in Aquarium, it would skip it completely, making the Eye inaccessible.
Fixed an issue where it was possible to go out of bounds while dashing during a Flashback in the Inverted Plaza.
Fixed two specific locations in the Park where Luca could get her head stuck in a wall from a bouncy tree leaf.
Fixed a location where Slide was needed to proceed in Buried Streets, but if wiggling Luca well enough in there would result in her getting stuck.
Added a ladder in the Sunken City, where a transition between two rooms wasn’t smooth. 🪜
Fixed the issue where, if Nightmare Luca in the Campus is defeated on one of the pillars, her item drops would be out of reach.
Adjusted the position of a few Peculiar Films to avoid confusion between the main and side quests of Professor Foss.
Affixes
Fixed the issue where having the Detachable Tail affix would heal Luca when being struck by the Kabuto projectiles (sowwyyyy).
Visual
Added the whip point to the tentacle walls for improved clarity on how to use them.
Fixed an issue where a certain NPC sprite would not be present in the room during a conversation in Inverted Plaza. (👻)
Fixed the Document Shredder sprite becoming invisible after leaving the Campus. (👻)
Combat
Fixed the Benchwarmer behaving erratically and becoming stuck after using one of their abilities.
Small balances on the Rusted Dockyard’s General.
UI
Fixed an Interact prompt briefly appearing in the General’s fight room in Inverted Plaza (no one probably noticed, but we did, and we were very annoyed by it aha).
Updated the ItemPickup layouts to dynamically scale down if text gets too tall.
Like a thrifted denim jacket, Possessor(s) is getting a patch on day one. Here's everything we've improved:
UI
Fixed an issue where Rhem’s “I want to talk” indicator would persist even though he didn’t want to talk
Fixed an issue where notifications for dropped items would display more than once
Fixed an issue where the player had to get uncomfortably close to Foss to have a chat
[p align="start"]Visual
Adjusted lighting/deco throughout many areas of the game to avoid visual oddities, inconsistencies, or intrusive elements
Adjusted collision throughout many areas of the game to avoid minor issues, unnecessary bumps, and out-of-bounds situations
Improved camera use and positioning throughout many areas of the game
Fixed a few issues with certain areas of the game, causing characters and objects to disappear
Improved the clarity of graphical logos representing teams, very important to the shipping and development of this game - Heart Machine and Devolver
Fixed an issue where certain HUD elements would no longer hide when it was appropriate
Fixed an issue where Baseball projectile VFX would not show in \
[p align="start"]Combat
Adjusted combat behaviors for some enemies and bosses, namely the lazy Kabuto
Adjusted some enemy arrangements for encounters
Fixed an issue that caused Explosive Barrels to be Non-Explosive (oops)
Fixed an issue that would cause the Rat King’s projectiles to push Luca through walls
Fixed Foxes being able to move heavy boxes
Fixed Cone Hulks not properly hiding in their cones
[p align="start"]Navigation
Fixed several instances where the player could not transition between several rooms as intended
Introduced the ability to be crushed by elevators (why are you there to begin with?)
[p align="start"]Performance
Made numerous adjustments throughout the game to improve performance
[p align="start"]Narrative
Adjusted several scenes to polish and improve story sequences
Fixed an issue that would cause some NPCs to offer dialogue despite leaving the area
Fixed an issue where NPCs would disappear when they should be present
[p align="start"]Audio
Fixed an issue where a Merchant’s background music was playing in the wrong room
[p align="start"]Localization
Fixed an issue with missing instances of localized text

Also to note on cross-saves - Hey everyone! We recently found out that some saves from the Summer Games Fest demo might carry over into the full release. Since we’ve made a ton of changes since then, those old saves could cause issues with story progression or data. To be safe, we recommend deleting any demo saves that might have transferred—plus, we’ve updated the intro and added new stuff you won’t want to miss!
